summary: TSMC filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its third-quarter 2026 earnings press release and conference presentation, not a special-situation event. Reported consolidated revenue of NT$1,494.24 billion, net income of NT$763.06 billion, and diluted EPS of NT$29.43 (US$4.60 per ADR), up 68.7% year-over-year; US-dollar revenue was $46.72 billion, gross margin 66.4% and operating margin 58.7%. Fourth-quarter revenue guidance is US$52.3-54.3 billion. The filing contains no transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics; it is an ordinary foreign-private-issuer operational update.
